question: Does the BFAR Region 8 BASIL announcement add concrete inland waterbody leads to the Eastern Visayas research queue?

source.title: BFAR 8 partners with EVMWB on Inland Fisheries Information Campaign
source.provider: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Regional Office VIII
source.access: Official BFAR Region 8 page and search-indexed article text reviewed. The article describes an inland-fisheries IEC event and 2025 BASIL target waters; it exposes no site-specific biological survey results or fish checklist.

programContext.name: Balik Sigla sa Ilog at Lawa (BASIL)
programContext.scopeAsDescribed: BFAR describes the national inland-fisheries program as restoring and maintaining life in inland waters such as rivers, reservoirs, and lakes.
componentsAsDescribed: lake or river rehabilitation or restoration
programContext.evidenceType: Official program-target waterbody discovery lead; not a completed fish inventory, current occurrence dataset, or validation that all named waters were surveyed.

assessment.coverageInterpretation: The article supplies five inland-water target leads across Samar, Biliran, Eastern Samar, Northern Samar, and Leyte. It names no target in Southern Leyte; that omission is not evidence that the province lacks inland waters or fish records.
assessment.identityLimits: Names are retained as printed in the announcement only. No aliases, hydrographic feature IDs, extent, or official boundary are confirmed.
assessment.speciesAdmission: No species assertion or occurrence is admissible from this source. Seek published fish surveys, project resource profiles, monitoring reports, and documented species-by-site results for each named water.
assessment.appReadiness: Not ready for app-facing fish presence, inventory, geometry, diet, safety, catchability, or legal content.

nextActions: Search for publicly accessible BFAR resource profiles, project completion reports, or monitoring outputs for each named waterbody; record access and survey scope before extracting taxa.
Start with Haropohop Swamp, Amantacop River, Loog/Bugasan Dams, Libertad Dam, and Hubas Dam as separate waterbody queues; do not merge nearby sites or reuse a waterbody name across provinces.
Maintain a separate inventory for Southern Leyte and every other Region VIII inland water; the 2025 program list is not a complete provincial waterbody inventory.
Do not infer presence, abundance, stocking, safety, or legal status from program selection or communication activities.

sources.supports: BFAR Region 8 page describes the 2025 BASIL inland-fisheries program components and names six program target waters across five provinces. It contains no species-level survey results.
